description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makuluwa, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District   - Cad. Map No. 810013
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) in the Galle district. The content focuses entirely on land registration, ownership determinations, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
